name: sheet
summary: A panel that slides in from an edge and is dragged back to dismiss, the touch form of a dialog.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Names the panel for assistive technology and shows at its top. Always required; hideTitle hides it visually.

properties.name: hideTitle
properties.description: Hides the title visually; it still names the panel.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A short line under the title, read out when the panel opens.

properties.name: closeLabel
properties.description: The close button's label and spoken name.

properties.name: closeOnOutsidePress
properties.description: Whether a press outside the sheet closes it. With modal false the default is false.

properties.name: side
properties.description: The edge the sheet slides in from and is dragged back to.

properties.name: modal
properties.description: Whether the sheet shuts off the rest of the page. false makes a panel beside a page the person keeps using: no backdrop and no focus trap.

slots.name: content
slots.description: The body; it scrolls when taller than the sheet.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The actions row, stacked full width on phones; primary action last.

events.name: close
events.description: The sheet closed: dragged away, by Escape, the close button or an outside press.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The close button and each footer action scale to the press scale, never under reduced motion.

accessibility.name: Its title.
accessibility.keyboard: A modal sheet keeps focus inside and Escape closes it; a non-modal one leaves focus where it was.
accessibility.web: A role="dialog" named by its title; aria-modal only when modal.
accessibility.apple: A presented sheet with detents, named by its title.
accessibility.windows: A flyout panel from the edge: UI Automation ControlType.Pane named by the title, with a Close button.
accessibility.android: A Compose ModalBottomSheet (or a side sheet for left and right): a node with a pane title from the title, a heading for it, and a Close button with the dismiss action.

cases.person: A sheet rising from the bottom with its title, a close button and a Save action.
A panel at the right edge; the page behind it stays usable.

deviations: snapPoints (resting heights) is web's and Apple's detents; not yet in the spec.
No drag to dismiss with a mouse; a touch screen drags it, and the close button and Escape always close it.
